verdict.rationale: a-Shell supports automation through Apple Shortcuts actions and scripts such as `.profile`, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any first-party way to version, review or roll back those automations: no git, no history of script or shortcut revisions, no diff or restore feature. Keeping script files and managing them by hand would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
